#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""One bounded stable58 inspection. No build, upgrade, acceptance or publication."""
import pathlib,json,time,subprocess,hashlib,xml.etree.ElementTree as ET,traceback
import navigator as nav
R=pathlib.Path.cwd();OUT=R/'evidence';OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True);records=[];STEP='initial';ROUTE='uninitialized'
def raw_capture(name):
 record=dict(name=name,host_route_annotation=ROUTE,locale=nav.LOCALE)
 # Independent operations: a failed UI dump/focus check must not suppress pixels.
 for key,args,suffix in [('window',('shell','dumpsys','window'),'.window.txt'),('xml',('exec-out','uiautomator','dump','/dev/tty'),'.raw.xml.txt'),('png',('exec-out','screencap','-p'),'.png')]:
  try:
   b=nav.adb(*args);(OUT/(name+suffix)).write_bytes(b);record[key]=dict(sha256=hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),bytes=len(b))
  except Exception as e:record[key]=dict(error=type(e).__name__)
 records.append(record);(OUT/'inspection-manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(records,indent=2))
def capture(name):
 raw_capture(name);tree,_=nav.snapshot();nav.current(tree)
def action(name,fn):
 global STEP
 STEP=name;fn();raw_capture(name);nav.window()
def open_settings():
 nav.root();nav.tap(nav.txt('settings'));nav.enter(nav.settings_guard)
def open_section(key,*details):
 open_settings();nav.settings_row(nav.txt(key));nav.enter(nav.anchors(nav.txt(key),*(nav.txt(x) for x in details)))
def open_appearance():
 open_section('appearance','theme','font');nav.bind(nav.appearance_guard)
EXPECTED_LANGUAGE='english'
LANGUAGE_OPTION_CHECKS=[]
def language_section_guard(tree):
 nav.anchors(nav.desc('back'),nav.txt('language'),nav.txt('app_language'))(tree)
 # A dialog can retain its underlying page. Its description/options must be gone.
 assert not nav.nodes(tree,nav.txt('app_language_description')), 'Language dialog not dismissed'
 assert not any(nav.nodes(tree,nav.language_option(k))for k in ['english','spanish','french']), 'Language option still present'
 # Pure predicate: never call control/current from the guard bound as current.
 label=nav.visible_unique(tree,nav.txt('app_language'));parents={c:p for p in tree.iter()for c in p};row=parents.get(label)
 assert row is not None and row.get('package')==nav.PKG and row.get('enabled')=='true' and row.get('clickable')=='true'
 assert nav.encloses(nav.bounds(row),nav.bounds(label))
 assert not any(x is not row and x.get('clickable')=='true'for x in row.iter('node')), 'Nested language summary actions'
 labels=[x.get('text')for x in row.iter('node')if x.get('text')]
 assert sorted(labels)==sorted([nav.value(nav.txt('app_language')),nav.value(nav.txt(EXPECTED_LANGUAGE))]), 'Wrong language summary'
def open_language_dialog(tag,*,from_home=False):
 if from_home:
  assert nav.LOCALE=='en', 'Spanish Settings-root route not part of this test'
  open_section('language','app_language');nav.bind(language_section_guard)
 else:nav.bind(language_section_guard)
 nav.settings_row(nav.txt('app_language'))
 raw_capture(tag+'-entry')
 nav.enter(nav.anchors(nav.txt('app_language_description'),nav.language_option('english'),nav.language_option('spanish'),nav.language_option('french')))
def checked_option(key,*,selected,actionable=False):
 signatures=[]
 for _ in range(2):
  tree,focus=nav.snapshot();nav.current(tree)
  label=nav.visible_unique(tree,nav.language_option(key));parents={c:p for p in tree.iter()for c in p};row=parents.get(label)
  assert row is not None and row.get('package')==nav.PKG and row.get('enabled')=='true' and row.get('checkable')=='true'
  assert row.get('checked')==str(selected).lower(), 'Unexpected language selected state'
  group=parents.get(row);assert group is not None and group.get('package')==nav.PKG
  named_rows=[parents[nav.visible_unique(tree,nav.language_option(k))]for k in ['english','spanish','french']]
  assert len({id(x)for x in named_rows})==3 and all(parents.get(x)is group for x in named_rows), 'Options not one exact dialog group'
  group_rows=[x for x in group if x.get('checkable')=='true']
  assert all(x.get('package')==nav.PKG and x.get('enabled')=='true'for x in group_rows)
  assert sum(x.get('checked')=='true'for x in group_rows)==1, 'Nonunique checked language'
  assert len([x for x in row.iter('node')if x.get('text')])==1
  rb,lb=nav.bounds(row),nav.bounds(label);assert nav.encloses(rb,lb)
  if actionable:
   assert not selected and row.get('clickable')=='true', 'Selected/nonclickable option is read-only'
   target=nav.control(tree,nav.language_option(key));assert target[0] is row and target[2]==rb, 'Language action escaped its owned row'
  signatures.append((focus,tuple(sorted(row.attrib.items())),tuple(sorted(label.attrib.items()))))
 assert signatures[0]==signatures[1], 'Language option changed'
 LANGUAGE_OPTION_CHECKS.append(dict(locale=nav.LOCALE,key=key,selected=selected,actionable=actionable,focus=signatures[0][0],row=dict(signatures[0][1]),label=dict(signatures[0][2])))
 (OUT/'locale-option-checks.json').write_text(json.dumps(LANGUAGE_OPTION_CHECKS,indent=2))
def select_unchecked_language(key,locale):
 global EXPECTED_LANGUAGE
 assert (nav.LOCALE,key,locale)in [('en','spanish','es'),('es','english','en')], 'Unscoped language transition'
 checked_option(key,selected=False,actionable=True)
 # Generic input safety is unchanged: enabled clickable owned exact row, no
 # nested clickable controls, stable enclosure/bounds and two agreeing reads.
 nav.tap(nav.language_option(key))
 nav.LOCALE=locale;EXPECTED_LANGUAGE=key
 # AppNavigator lives in MainViewModel across configuration recreation. Require
 # this exact translated Language section, including no dialog and new summary.
 # Home/unknown landing is a stop, not fallback navigation or a new launch.
 nav.auto_closed()

MODE='language-only'
def run():
 global STEP,ROUTE,EXPECTED_LANGUAGE
 nav.INSPECTION_MODE=MODE
 nav.STRINGS.clear();nav.LOCALE='en';EXPECTED_LANGUAGE='english'
 for bundle,path in [('app','app/src/main/res'),('shared','sharedUi/src/commonMain/composeResources')]:
  base={n.get('name'):''.join(n.itertext()).replace("\\'", "'")for n in ET.parse(R/'archive-tree'/path/'values/strings.xml').getroot().findall('string')}
  overlay={n.get('name'):''.join(n.itertext()).replace("\\'", "'")for n in ET.parse(R/'archive-tree'/path/'values-es/strings.xml').getroot().findall('string')}
  nav.STRINGS['en',bundle]=base;nav.STRINGS['es',bundle]={**base,**overlay}
 (OUT/'locale-transition-plan.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(initial='en',temporary_test_only='es',final='en',explicit_actions=['en-to-es','es-to-en'],no_spanish_product_coverage=True,no_user_device_or_account_effects=True),indent=2))
 nav.adb('shell','svc','wifi','disable');nav.adb('shell','svc','data','disable');nav.adb('logcat','-b','all','-c')
 (OUT/'install-stable.txt').write_bytes(nav.adb('install',R/'predecessor.apk'))
 # No explicit-component fallback if the normal route fails. This disposable
 # emulator has exactly TWO planned starts: normal initial, explicit cold reopen.
 diagnostic_failures=[]
 for name,args in [('package-components',('shell','dumpsys','package',nav.PKG)),('launcher-query',('shell','cmd','package','query-activities','--brief','-a','android.intent.action.MAIN','-c','android.intent.category.LAUNCHER','-p',nav.PKG)),('launcher-resolution',('shell','cmd','package','resolve-activity','--brief','-a','android.intent.action.MAIN','-c','android.intent.category.LAUNCHER','-p',nav.PKG))]:
  try:(OUT/(name+'.txt')).write_bytes(nav.adb(*args))
  except BaseException as e:
   (OUT/(name+'.txt')).write_text(json.dumps(dict(command=list(args),error_type=type(e).__name__,partial_output=(getattr(e,'stdout',None) or b'').decode(errors='replace'))));diagnostic_failures.append(name)
 if diagnostic_failures:raise AssertionError(('Incomplete prelaunch diagnostics',diagnostic_failures))
 # Component identity derives from the actual installed package and same binary
 # manifest reviewed in prior runs, then actual returned launch/focus/XML.
 nav.verify_launcher_manifest((OUT/'predecessor.apk.manifest.txt').read_text())
 package=(OUT/'package-components.txt').read_text()
 assert 'com.music.bitchord.LauncherSpool' in package
 for name in ['launcher-query','launcher-resolution']:
  lines=[x.strip() for x in (OUT/(name+'.txt')).read_text().splitlines() if '/' in x]
  assert lines==[nav.PKG+'/com.music.bitchord.LauncherSpool'], ('Normal route unresolved',name,lines)
 STEP='launcher-alias';nav.launch_named('launcher-alias-result',normal=True);raw_capture('onboarding-initial')
 STEP='onboarding';nav.onboard(already_launched=True);ROUTE='home';capture('home-en')
 STEP='english-preference';open_language_dialog('language-before',from_home=True);ROUTE='language-dialog';capture('language-dialog-en-before-selection')
 checked_option('english',selected=True)
 STEP='temporary-test-spanish';select_unchecked_language('spanish','es');ROUTE='language-section-es';capture('language-es-section')
 open_language_dialog('language-es');ROUTE='language-dialog-es';checked_option('spanish',selected=True);checked_option('english',selected=False,actionable=True);capture('language-dialog-es-selected')
 STEP='restore-explicit-english';select_unchecked_language('english','en');ROUTE='language-section-en';capture('language-en-restored-section')
 open_language_dialog('language-after');ROUTE='language-dialog';checked_option('english',selected=True);capture('language-dialog-en-selected');nav.back();nav.root()
 STEP='cold-reopen';nav.adb('shell','am','force-stop',nav.PKG);nav.launch_named('cold-launch-result')
 # The app was force-stopped, so the old UI route stack no longer exists.
 # Bind the new direct-component Home before clearing only the host route stack.
 nav.bind(nav.home_guard);nav.ROUTES.clear();ROUTE='home';capture('cold-home-en')
 open_language_dialog('language-cold',from_home=True);checked_option('english',selected=True);ROUTE='language-dialog';capture('cold-english-selected')
 (OUT/'INSPECTION-SEQUENCE-COMPLETE.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(mode=MODE,no_acceptance=True,stable_version=58,records=len(records),launcher_style_alias_launch=True,explicit_cold_reopens=1,candidate_built=False,coverage=MODE,limits=['Only this named rehearsal, not all-in-one coverage','No baseline58-to59 upgrade proof','Temporary Spanish is test setup only, not product language coverage','No APK/source build or signing','No live playback/OTA','Manual full-title and zero-count pixel review required for local mode']),indent=2))
def main():
 try:run()
 except BaseException as e:
  (OUT/'inspection-stop.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(step=STEP,host_route_annotation=ROUTE,error_type=type(e).__name__,reason=str(e)),indent=2));raw_capture('first-ambiguity');raise
 finally:
  for name,args in [('logcat',('logcat','-b','all','-d')),('exit-info',('shell','dumpsys','activity','exit-info',nav.PKG)),('activity-state',('shell','dumpsys','activity','activities')),('process-state',('shell','ps','-A'))]:
   try:(OUT/(name+'.txt')).write_bytes(nav.adb(*args))
   except BaseException as e:(OUT/(name+'.txt')).write_text(json.dumps(dict(error_type=type(e).__name__,partial_output=(getattr(e,'stdout',None) or b'').decode(errors='replace')),indent=2))
  # Media setup/cleanup is not part of this candidate's execution path.
  assert not nav.MEDIA_GRANT_ATTEMPTED and not nav.AUDIO_ATTEMPTED, 'Unexpected media effect in no-media rehearsal'
  (OUT/'no-media-effects.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(mode=MODE,media_grant_attempted=False,audio_attempted=False,not_cleanup_proof=True)))
if __name__=='__main__':main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Strict file binding and actual apksigner/aapt verification, proposal only."""
import pathlib,subprocess,json,hashlib,os,re,sys,urllib.request,shutil,tarfile
R=pathlib.Path.cwd();D=R/'accepted-input';E=R/'evidence';E.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
CERT='a736ba238a0f10d07f9197ca9ba51eb26f46576ba428ed12723434da47b11dee';AFTER='fa387cc6eece49fca1be0355b37e78ee2fef6e78'
def sha(p):
 h=hashlib.sha256()
 with open(p,'rb') as f:
  for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1048576),b''):h.update(b)
 return h.hexdigest()
def cmd(*a):return subprocess.check_output(a,text=True,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
def get(url,p):
 with urllib.request.urlopen(url) as a,open(p,'wb') as f:shutil.copyfileobj(a,f)
def apk(p,code,name,abi):
 tools=pathlib.Path(os.environ['ANDROID_HOME'])/'build-tools/35.0.0'
 cert=cmd(str(tools/'apksigner'),'verify','--verbose','--print-certs',str(p));bad=cmd(str(tools/'aapt'),'dump','badging',str(p));xml=cmd(str(tools/'aapt'),'dump','xmltree',str(p),'AndroidManifest.xml')
 (E/(p.name+'.cert.txt')).write_text(cert);(E/(p.name+'.badging.txt')).write_text(bad);(E/(p.name+'.manifest.txt')).write_text(xml)
 assert re.search(r"package: name='app.spool.music' versionCode='"+str(code)+r"' versionName='"+re.escape(name)+r"'",bad)
 actual=re.findall(r'^Signer #\d+ certificate SHA-256 digest: ([0-9a-f]+)$',cert,re.M);assert actual==[CERT],actual
 for flag in ['debuggable','testOnly']:
  lines=[line for line in xml.splitlines() if 'android:'+flag+'(' in line]
  assert all(re.search(r'=\(type 0x12\)0x0$',line.strip()) for line in lines),(flag,lines)
 assert 'application-debuggable' not in bad
 native=re.search(r'^native-code: (.+)$',bad,re.M);assert native
 abis=set(re.findall(r"'([^']+)'",native[1]));assert abis==({'armeabi-v7a','arm64-v8a','x86_64'} if abi=='universal' else {'arm64-v8a'}),abis
 assert "sdkVersion:'26'" in bad
 # The receiver/provider identities must survive shrink/packaging. Actual Updates UI is the runtime enablement gate.
 assert 'android.permission.REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES' in bad
 return dict(sha256=sha(p),size=p.stat().st_size,abis=sorted(abis),certificate_sha256=CERT)
def verify():
 m=json.loads((D/'manifest.json').read_text());assert m['schema']==1 and m['candidate_tree']==AFTER
 assert m['base_commit']=='e290e8c945cc51d744445ebffb3cdf6c483eff17' and m['base_tree']=='bcb909208d5345fe6f6c0e8f7829b1c87821b779'
 assert m['run_id']==os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ID'] and m['run_attempt']==os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT'] and m['workflow_sha']==os.environ['GITHUB_SHA']
 expected={'source.tar.gz','Spool-2.1.2-universal.apk','Spool-2.1.2-arm64-v8a.apk'};assert set(m['files'])==expected and {p.name for p in D.iterdir()}==expected|{'manifest.json'}
 for n,v in m['files'].items():assert (D/n).stat().st_size==v['size'] and sha(D/n)==v['sha256']
 # Reconstruct full archived Git tree without changing product or loading scripts.
 temp=R/'archive-tree';assert not temp.exists();temp.mkdir()
 with tarfile.open(D/'source.tar.gz') as t:
  for item in t.getmembers():
   parts=pathlib.PurePosixPath(item.name).parts;assert (item.isfile() or item.isdir()) and not item.issym() and not item.islnk() and '..' not in parts and not item.name.startswith('/')
   assert not any(k in parts for k in ['.git','spool-debug.keystore','keystore.properties'])
  t.extractall(temp)
 subprocess.run(['git','init','-q'],cwd=temp,check=True);subprocess.run(['git','add','-A'],cwd=temp,check=True)
 assert subprocess.check_output(['git','write-tree'],cwd=temp,text=True).strip()==AFTER
 app=(temp/'app/build.gradle.kts').read_text();assert app.count('buildConfigField("boolean", "SEPARATELY_PROVIDED_UPDATES", "false")')==2
 result={}
 for abi in ['universal','arm64-v8a']:result[abi]=apk(D/('Spool-2.1.2-'+abi+'.apk'),59,'2.1.2',abi)
 (E/'verified-files.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(run_id=m['run_id'],manifest_sha256=sha(D/'manifest.json'),apks=result),indent=2))
 # Snapshot unchanged inputs for post-emulator check.
 (E/'input-inventory.json').write_text(json.dumps({p.name:sha(p) for p in D.iterdir()},sort_keys=True,indent=2))
def predecessor():
 latest=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen('https://api.github.com/repos/JoyalGeorge2006/spool/releases/latest'))
 assert latest['tag_name']=='v2.1.1' and not latest['draft'] and not latest['prerelease'],'Live predecessor changed; stop for version/scope review'
 assets={a['name']:a for a in latest['assets']};assert len(assets)==len(latest['assets'])
 target=assets['spool.apk'];assert target['browser_download_url']=='https://github.com/JoyalGeorge2006/spool/releases/download/v2.1.1/spool.apk'
 get(target['browser_download_url'],R/'predecessor.apk');assert sha(R/'predecessor.apk')=='a2049d0546bd17791014a59f84a40f258a214445d8b4aa6a32349335f1bb0ba1'
 assert target['size']==(R/'predecessor.apk').stat().st_size
 r=apk(R/'predecessor.apk',58,'2.1.1','universal');r.update(release_url=latest['html_url'],asset_url=target['browser_download_url'],asset_id=target['id'])
 (E/'predecessor.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2))
def after():
 original=json.loads((E/'input-inventory.json').read_text());assert {p.name:sha(p) for p in D.iterdir()}==original
 assert (E/'DEVICE-CHECKS-COMPLETE.json').is_file()
 # Multi-buffer crash/ANR and actual exit-state gates since initial logcat clear.
 all_log=(E/'logcat.txt').read_text(errors='replace');crash=(E/'crashes.txt').read_text(errors='replace');exits=(E/'exit-info.txt').read_text(errors='replace')
 assert not re.search(r'(?:ANR in app\.spool\.music|am_anr.*app\.spool\.music|Process: app\.spool\.music|Fatal signal.*app\.spool\.music)',all_log+'\\n'+crash)
 assert not re.search(r'reason=.*(?:CRASH|ANR|CRASH_NATIVE)',exits),exits
 from PIL import Image
 shots=json.loads((E/'screenshots.json').read_text());required={'baseline-offline-playlist','baseline-dark-preference','baseline-malayalam-home','baseline-language-selected','after-malayalam-home','after-offline-playlist','after-dark-preference','after-language-selected','after-settings-light','production-updater-enabled','production-for-you-after-tap','production-mood-grid-top','production-mood-grid-bottom','production-replay-top','production-replay-scrolled','cold-reopen-0','cold-reopen-1','cold-reopen-2','after-three-reopens-prefs'}
 assert len(shots)==len(required) and {s['name'] for s in shots}==required
 for s in shots:
  p=E/(s['name']+'.png');assert sha(p)==s['png_sha256'] and p.stat().st_size==s['bytes']
  with Image.open(p) as img:img.load();assert img.format=='PNG' and img.width>0 and img.height>0
  assert (E/(s['name']+'.xml')).is_file() and s['window'].split('/')[0]=='app.spool.music'
 assert all(s['locale']=='ml' for s in shots if s['name'] in {'baseline-malayalam-home','baseline-language-selected','after-malayalam-home','after-language-selected','after-offline-playlist','after-dark-preference'})
 # Re-check successor race after device acceptance too.
 latest=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen('https://api.github.com/repos/JoyalGeorge2006/spool/releases/latest'));assert latest['tag_name']=='v2.1.1'
 (E/'AUTOMATED-CHECKS-COMPLETE.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(manual_pixel_acceptance=False,run_id=os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ID'],workflow_sha=os.environ['GITHUB_SHA'],manifest_sha256=sha(D/'manifest.json'),device_evidence_sha256=sha(E/'DEVICE-CHECKS-COMPLETE.json'),limits=['API34 x86_64 universal only','phone-only no bundled watch','signed-out local preferences and offline playlist only','manual pixel review remains required','no live OTA publication/discovery proof']),indent=2))
if __name__=='__main__':{'verify':verify,'predecessor':predecessor,'after':after}[sys.argv[1]]()
